cases.name: Dana Magnuson
cases.about: She worked as a bus dispatcher for Katy ISD. Her son, Tyler Pitney said his mom was a devoted mother who he talked to on the phone every day. He says she ran marathons, loved cooking for the family, and worked long shifts for Katy ISD transportation - where she worked as a transportation employee. "She was the most loving person, the kindest, sweetest soul anyone's ever known, and its... This person took a true angel from this world," he said.
cases.relationship: Handyman / repairman / service provider; Landlord / neighbor / roommate / tenant
cases.narrative: Her body was found in the backyard shed, but investigators believe she was first attacked in her hot tub on her patio behind her house.
